description: Use this when the customer has picked specific teas.co.uk products and wants to buy them straight away, for example from a product result. It puts exactly these items in a fresh basket at live prices and returns a secure link to pay on teas.co.uk; the basket built earlier is not used or changed. checkout_session holds items: each item needs an id from find_products and a quantity of 1 to 99, up to 20 items. offerId from the product feed is tried when an id is not found. Display fields (name, description, images, url, merchant_name, price) never change what is charged. Items that cannot be found are listed in unavailable and the rest go ahead; if none are found it returns an error. Nothing is charged until the customer pays on teas.co.uk. To check out the basket they built, use checkout_link.

checkout_session.description: The products to buy: items lists each product id (from find_products) and quantity, up to 20 products.

items.description: Each product and how many, up to 20 products.

description.description: Optional, for display only; not used.

id.description: Product id (the SKU in the teas.co.uk product feed).

images.description: Optional image links, for display only; not used.

merchant_name.description: Optional, for display only; not used.

name.description: Optional product name for display; teas.co.uk uses its own.

offerId.description: Optional offer id from the product feed.

price.description: The price as displayed. teas.co.uk always uses its own live price.

url.description: Optional product link, for display only; not used.
